## MOCK SPEC
An actual real-time Unreal Engine game viewport screenshot of an original magical British railway platform inspired by the idea of a hidden platform nine and three quarters. This is an exact achievable 3D environment screenshot, not a painting, not concept art, not a photograph, no movie still, no recognizable actors, no film logos. No application chrome or HUD.

Landscape composition, eye-level camera at 1.7 metres, 30mm lens, looking down a long Victorian platform toward a softly sunlit arched station exit. On the LEFT, a large detailed dark scarlet and black steam locomotive is parked nose toward the camera, its round black smokebox, brass trim, front buffers, pipes, rivets, red running wheels and connecting rods clearly visible. Its boiler stretches back into a burgundy passenger carriage along the left side of the platform. The train fills the left half of the view but stays fully visible with breathing room above and below. Steel rails and dark gravel occupy the lower-left foreground.

On the RIGHT, the raised stone platform leads away in one-point perspective. A richly detailed warm red-brown brick wall has repeating recessed tall arched window bays with dirty emerald-green iron frames and amber light inside. A hanging round cream enamel platform sign reading only "9 3/4" is mounted on an ornate black wrought-iron bracket at the upper-right third of the image. Below it: an old brass luggage trolley carrying three weathered leather trunks and a small round empty brass bird cage, with a folded wine-red blanket. Wooden benches, a few battered suitcases, vintage station lanterns, and small paper departure notices dress the platform. The scene is unoccupied, no people.

Above: a vaulted glass-and-dark-iron train shed, repeated elegant arched steel ribs, side columns, diagonal braces, and translucent dusty roof panels. The architecture encloses the composition, at a believable human scale. Long warm late-afternoon shafts of light cross the cool blue-grey haze. Thin steam rises from the locomotive chimney and drifts low beside the wheels, not a giant opaque smoke cloud. Warm pools of golden light from lanterns on the brick wall. Cool teal ambient light in the iron roof and shadows.

Materials must be grounded physically based game materials: irregular brick and mortar, rubbed and scratched painted scarlet metal, blackened steel, subtly patinated brass, worn honey-brown leather, fine stone paving joints, wet patches with restrained reflections, soot on the roof. Crisp close detail, clean readable silhouette, nuanced shadows, cinematic but naturally exposed. No exaggerated bloom, no cartoon styling, no plastic assets, no modern objects, no excessive clutter, no illegible fantasy lettering.
